Prompt (no ref)
Restore the attached video. Apologies for the video's content. I know it's extremely [purple]! No questions, no explanatory text, just the restored video.

Testing @AIatMeta’s new Muse Image and I’m genuinely impressed.💜

Make sure turn on the Thinking Mode to get the best result. 
I start with an elegant older Japanese lady and pushed it hard with precise editing. 
The skin texture and realism are excellent. 🔥

What stood out most:
1. Extremely precise editing while keeping the original person 100% consistent (face, wrinkles, skin details)
2. Strong instruction following
3. Agentic reasoning

Still early days, but Muse Image feels like a solid step forward for practical use — fashion, editorial, film, product viz, and photo editing.

What do you think, have you tried it yet?

Beyond the stars. ✨

I’ve been experimenting with the @reve image model, and its ability to understand design intent is next-level. 
I generated the visual, and then prompted it to add the typography, without even giving it the exact text.
The result? 
Pure elegance. 

It’s not just generating pixels; it’s designing with genuine taste.💜

This flower grows in my garden. 💜
I've loved Butterfly Pea Flower since I was a kid,  it's this deep blue-purple color, just beautiful on its own.

Here's the magic part: squeeze lime or lemon into a drink made with it, and it turns from blue to purple right in front of you. Real chemistry, not a filter.✨

So I turned it into a brand using one chat with @AdobeFirefly AI Assistant.
